newsitem.title: USA: PageNet expects 1996 revenue to rise 25 pct.
newsitem.headline: PageNet expects 1996 revenue to rise 25 pct.

text.p: PageNet said it expects its 1996 net revenues to increase 25 percent from 1995 and to end the year with about 9 million pagers in service, a 34 percent increase over last year.
The company also said its 1996 domestic operating cash flow margins will show about a one percent increase over 1995's.

The company it expects to start selling its VoiceNow service in the Dallas/Forth Worth area in February for about $10 a month, it added. The service will impact cash flow margins, although the company did not say by how much.
